answer_preview: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days and is free on orders over $50. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $14.99. Please note: Orders placed between December 15 and December 31 may need 2 extra business days.

Northwind Goods offers a full refund on most items within 30 days of purchase. To request a refund, contact support with your order number or ask our assistant to start one for you. Please note: Final-sale items and gift cards are not eligible for a refund. If you'd like me to start a refund, just tell me your order number.

Every Northwind Goods product comes with a 1-year limited warranty from the date of delivery. The warranty covers faults in materials and workmanship under normal use. Please note: The warranty does not cover accidental damage, misuse, or normal wear and tear.
You can delete your Northwind Goods account at any time from Settings > Privacy > Delete account. Deleting your account removes any saved cards and unused store credit.
